entries.title: Job 26:2
segments: How have you given help to him who has no power! how have you been the salvation of the arm which has no strength!

entries.title: Job 26:3
segments: How have you given teaching to him who has no wisdom, and fully made clear true knowledge!

entries.title: Job 26:4
segments: To whom have your words been said? and whose spirit came out from you?

entries.title: Job 26:5
segments: ¶The shades in the underworld are shaking; the waters and those living in them.

entries.title: Job 26:6
segments: The underworld is uncovered before him, and Destruction has no veil.

entries.title: Job 26:7
segments: By his hand the north is stretched out in space, and the earth is hanging on nothing.

entries.title: Job 26:8
segments: By him the waters are shut up in his thick clouds, and the cloud does not give way under them.

entries.title: Job 26:9
segments: By him the face of his high seat is veiled, and his cloud stretched out over it.

entries.title: Job 26:10
segments: By him a circle is marked out on the face of the waters, to the limits of the light and the dark.

entries.title: Job 26:11
segments: The pillars of heaven are shaking, and are overcome by his sharp words.

entries.title: Job 26:12
segments: By his power the sea was made quiet; and by his wisdom Rahab was wounded.

entries.title: Job 26:13
segments: By his wind the heavens become bright: by his hand the quickly moving snake was cut through.

entries.title: Job 26:14
segments: See, these are only the outskirts of his ways; and how small is that which comes to our ears about him! But the thunder of his acts of power is outside all knowledge.
